# UseThisSI

> One top AI tool pick per job for builders, vibe coders, AI agent tinkerers and indie game devs. Directory data last checked 2026-10-20; each tool page shows its own last-checked date.

## Use cases
- [Vibe-code an app or landing page](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/vibe-code-an-app-or-landing-page/): top pick Lovable. Chat-to-full-stack app with hosting; easiest on-ramp. Free tier: Yes (5 build credits/day). Paid from $25/mo Pro ($21/mo billed annually) (checked 2026-10-19).
- [AI coding assistant](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/ai-coding-assistant/): top pick Cursor. Leading AI IDE with cloud agents. Free tier: Yes (limited). Paid from $8/mo Plus (Grok models only); $30/mo Premium (checked 2026-10-19).
- [Set up or run AI agents](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/set-up-or-run-ai-agents/): top pick n8n. Open-source agent and workflow builder. Free tier: Yes (self-host Community Edition); Cloud free trial. Paid from €20/mo Starter, billed annually (checked 2026-10-20).
- [Automate workflows](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/automate-workflows/): top pick Make. Visual automation at less than half Zapier's entry price. Free tier: Yes (1,000 credits/mo). Paid from $9/mo Core billed annually (10,000 credits) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Make game art and sprites](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/make-game-art-and-sprites/): top pick Scenario. Style-trained, consistent game assets. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day; personal use only). Paid from $15/mo Starter (monthly; annual saves 33%) (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Generate music and SFX](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/generate-music-and-sfx/): top pick Suno. Best song gen with commercial rights on Pro. Free tier: Yes (50 credits/day, no commercial use). Paid from $8/mo Pro billed yearly, $10 monthly (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Edit and generate video](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/edit-and-generate-video/): top pick Runway. Pro-grade generative video. Free tier: Yes (125 one-time credits). Paid from $12/mo Standard billed annually, $15 monthly (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Write content](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/write-content/): top pick Claude. Best long-form writing voice. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $17/mo Pro annual, $20 monthly (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Research](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/research/): top pick Perplexity. Fast cited answers. Free tier: Yes. Paid from $17/mo Pro billed annually (checked 2026-10-18).
- [Voice and TTS](https://www.usethissi.com/use-cases/voice-and-tts/): top pick ElevenLabs. Most realistic voices. Free tier: Yes (10k credits). Paid from $6/mo Starter (annual ~$5; $1 first-month promo ended Oct 18) (checked 2026-10-19).

## Recent releases
- 2026-10-20: Mintlify Autopilot beta: always-on agent that opens doc-update PRs when code changes (250 credits per PR) (https://www.mintlify.com/blog/autopilot)
- 2026-10-19: GitHub Copilot retires GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, GPT-5 mini, Gemini 3.7 Flash and Grok 4.5 (suggested: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6 Luna, Gemini 3.8 Flash, Grok 4.7) (https://github.blog/changelog/2026-10-19-github-copilot-models-deprecated-on-october-19-2026/)
- 2026-10-19: Notion Agents rebuilt: own computer and browser, Auto model router, connect your ChatGPT plan, new AI credit system (https://www.notion.com/releases/2026-10-19)
- 2026-10-19: MiniMax M3.1 Flash GA: 1M-context agent and coding model at $0.15/$0.60 per 1M tokens (weights later) (https://www.minimax.io/blog/minimax-m31f)
- 2026-10-19: Appwrite MCP Events: event-driven agents via MCP (SEP-3415) without polling (https://appwrite.io/changelog/entry/2026-10-19)
- 2026-10-16: Reflection Beam: 501B MoE open weights (Apache 2.0), 23B active, 1M context for coding/agents (https://reflection.ai/blog/beam-is-available)
- 2026-10-15: ElevenLabs Instant Soundtracks: auto-scored music plus timed sound effects for uploaded videos (ElevenCreative, ElevenMusic, API) (https://elevenlabs.io/blog/introducing-instant-soundtracks)
- 2026-10-15: Kling 4.0 launches: native 30-second video, up to 15 reference assets and 10 keyframes, MCP and CLI access (API coming soon) (https://ir.kuaishou.com/news-releases/news-release-details/kling-ai-officially-launches-next-generation-kling-40-raising/)

## FAQ
- Q: How do you pick a top tool? A: One Top pick per use case based on fit for builders, plus honest free-tier and starting paid price with a per-tool last-checked date.
- Q: Are affiliate links labeled? A: Yes. Affiliate outbound links use rel=sponsored and are disclosed on /about/#affiliates.
- Q: Where is pricing verified? A: On each tool page under Last checked. Prices come from vendor pages; unverified fields stay labeled.
- Q: How do I get the weekday brief and the free AI Stack Kit? A: Subscribe at https://www.usethissi.com/#newsletter or https://usethissi.beehiiv.com/subscribe.
